title: Bending of Canonical and G/T Mismatched DNAs.
authors: Bouchal, Tomas; Durnik, Ivo; Kulhanek, Petr
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用偏置分子动力学模拟研究G/T错配DNA的弯曲特性及苯环插入对弯曲能的影响，虽未直接建模TF-DNA，但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作中的DNA弯曲机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合研究。
abstract: Mismatched base pairs alter the flexibility and intrinsic curvature of DNA. The role of such DNA features is not fully understood in the mismatch repair pathway. MutS/DNA complexes exhibit DNA bending, PHE intercalation, and changes of base-pair parameters near the mismatch. Recently, we have shown that base-pair opening in the absence of MutS can discriminate mismatches from canonical base pairs better than DNA bending. However, DNA bending in the absence of MutS was found to be rather challenging to describe correctly. Here, we present a computational study on the DNA bending of canonical and G/T mismatched DNAs. Five types of geometric parameters covering template-based bending toward the experimental DNA structure, global, and local geometry parameters were employed in biased molecular dynamics in the absence of MutS. None of these parameters showed higher discrimination than the base-pair opening. Only roll could induce a sharply localized bending of DNA as observed in the experimental MutS/DNA structure. Further, we demonstrated that the intercalation of benzene mimicking PHE decreases the energetic cost of DNA bending without any effect on mismatch discrimination.
abstract_zh: 错配碱基对改变了DNA的柔韧性和固有曲率。在错配修复途径中，这类DNA特征的作用尚未完全明了。MutS/DNA复合物表现出DNA弯曲、PHE插入以及错配附近碱基对参数的变化。近期，我们已证明，在无MutS情况下，碱基对打开比DNA弯曲更能区分错配与标准碱基对。然而，在无MutS情况下，DNA弯曲的正确描述颇具挑战性。在此，我们呈现了一项关于标准DNA和G/T错配DNA弯曲的计算研究。在无MutS的偏置分子动力学中，采用了五种几何参数，涵盖基于模板的朝向实验DNA结构的弯曲、全局及局部几何参数。这些参数中无一显示出比碱基对打开更高的区分度。仅roll参数能诱导出如实验MutS/DNA结构中观察到的DNA尖锐局部弯曲。此外，我们证明了模拟PHE的苯插入降低了DNA弯曲的能量成本，但对错配区分无任何影响。
